Maya (People Ops): Hey team 10s ask1 helping make a tiny, pasteable "one-line+bullets" goal prompt for self-reviews and manager notes. Needs to be skim-friendly and copy/paste into the form. Thoughts? :seedling:
Diego (Eng Manager): Love it. My go-to is 4 lines: objective, why, metric+baseline, ask from manager. Super quick to read. Example I use: 
```
Objective: Cut inference costs for embeddings pipeline by 15%
Why: Lower unit cost to support freemium growth
Metric: cost per 1k embeddings ($) 1 baseline $0.78 -> target $0.66
Manager ask: unblock infra quota increase + review quantization PR
```
Priya (Senior PM): Nice. Can we add a single "customer impact" line for cross-functional clarity? Even one short sentence helps PMs during calibration.
Ava (Staff SWE): Also adding "tradeoffs" helps reviewers quickly see expected regressions vs savings. Example: "tradeoffs: slight embedding cosine variance ~0.5%". And include 1 link to the top PR or issue.
Maya (People Ops): These are great. I'll assemble a tiny template pack: 1) single-line summary version, 2) 3-bullet template for self-review, 3) manager 3-question recap. Quick draft below for feedback.
Diego (Eng Manager): Thumbs up. Suggest replacing 'Manager ask' with 'Blocking asks' so it's explicit. Also ask people to add numbers (PRs, dashboards).
Maya (People Ops): Draft pack: 
```
One-line summary: <Objective> | <Key metric + baseline->target> | <Top ask from manager>
3-bullet self-review:
- Outcome: 1-2 short sentences + link to PR/issue
- Metric: baseline -> result (include dashboard link if available)
- Context & tradeoffs: 1 line on quality/cost tradeoffs
Manager 3Q recap:
1) Outcome verdict (met/partially/met-exception)
2) Blockers removed + help needed next quarter
3) Calibration note (compare to org expectations)
Tone guidance: be factual, include data, call out help needed, avoid humblebrag language.
```
Priya (Senior PM): This is perfect for cross-functional folks. Can you add a one-liner on where to paste it (self-review form link)? Also remind folks about deadline June 2.
Ava (Staff SWE): Minor nit: include a sample regression blameless summary line: "Regressions: small perf regression in X, root cause Y, mitigation Z". Saves time in calibration.
hr-bot: Reminder: Performance window opens in 5 days. Timeline + FAQ: https://intra.redwood.ai/hr/perf (read-only). :bell:
Maya (People Ops): Updated version I'll post in the performance templates doc and pin in #people-ops. Final checklist I'll include: 1) paste template into form 2) add PR/dashboard links 3) check tone checklist 4) submit by June 2. Thanks all! :sparkles:
